title: AI Interviews
summary: Video, voice, conversational AI and live coding interviews available 24/7.
headline: Interview every candidate, *on their schedule, not yours*
lede: TalentPool365 runs structured interviews automatically, by video, voice, chat or live coding. Every candidate gets the same fair experience, and your team gets scored, searchable results without scheduling a single call.
sectionIntro: TalentPool365 runs structured interviews automatically, by video, voice, chat or live coding. Every candidate gets the same fair experience, and your team gets scored, searchable results without scheduling a single call.

capabilities.title: Automated Video Interviews
capabilities.tagline: Meet more candidates without more meetings.
capabilities.body: Candidates record answers to your questions whenever it suits them. Your team reviews responses at their own pace, so first-round interviews no longer depend on calendars and time zones.
points: Role-specific question sets, ready-made or custom
Candidates respond anytime from any device
Recordings with transcripts for quick review
Share candidate responses with hiring managers in one click

capabilities.title: Voice-Based Interviews
capabilities.tagline: A real conversation, no video needed.
capabilities.body: Voice interviews are ideal for screening at scale and for roles where communication matters most, such as support, sales and operations. Candidates join with just a phone or laptop microphone.
points: AI asks questions and listens to spoken answers
Evaluates clarity, fluency and relevance of responses
Works well for high-volume and phone-first screening
Lower bandwidth needs than video

capabilities.title: Conversational AI Interviews
capabilities.tagline: Interviews that feel like a conversation, not a form.
capabilities.body: Our AI interviewer asks follow-up questions based on what the candidate says, digging deeper into experience and reasoning the way a skilled recruiter would.
points: Adaptive follow-up questions based on each answer
Covers experience, motivation and role-specific topics
Consistent structure so every candidate is assessed fairly
Available 24/7, in the candidate’s preferred time slot

capabilities.title: Coding Interviews
capabilities.tagline: See how developers think, not just what they know.
capabilities.body: Run live coding sessions in a built-in editor. Evaluate problem-solving approach, code quality and technical depth in a real working environment.
points: Online code editor supporting popular programming languages
Real-time code execution and automated test cases
Replay of the coding session to review the approach
Questions matched to the role and seniority level

capabilities.title: Proctoring & Monitoring
capabilities.tagline: Keep every interview honest and fair.
capabilities.body: Protect the integrity of your hiring process with smart monitoring that flags suspicious behavior, so you can trust the results.
points: Identity verification before the interview begins
Tab-switch and screen activity detection
Flags for unusual behavior, reviewed by your team
Candidates are informed about monitoring upfront

capabilities.title: Interview Analytics
capabilities.tagline: Turn every interview into a clear hiring insight.
capabilities.body: Stop relying on gut feeling. Get structured scores, summaries and comparisons so your team can make decisions with evidence.
points: Automatic transcripts and answer summaries
Scorecards by skill, communication and role fit
Side-by-side comparison of interviewed candidates
Dashboards showing interview completion and time-to-hire trends

closingCta.headline: Interview smarter. Hire faster.
closingCta.body: See how TalentPool365 turns first-round interviews into a one-click process.
